    Projective--injective coordinates in the standard mesh category #

    In the contravariant standard-mesh module category used by the Bongartz--Gabriel recovery argument, Riedtmann condition (c) identifies the injective D Hom(p,-) at a projective vertex with a contravariant representable. Hence this injective coordinate is projective. Its canonical simple socle is an essential submodule.
